Off by default. Injects recent memory rows and outline tail into the system prompt (token-limited).

Pros:
• Long sessions: prefetch text stays stable between memory/outline maintenance, improving API prefix cache hits
• Fewer tool calls for read_history_memory / read_outline

Cons:
• Uses system token budget (default ~900 tokens)
• One cache miss when maintenance updates memory or outline
• May lag behind live table edits; use tools for the latest data
